description: Post-training-only (10,398 rows) direct SFT from one shared untrained LoRA: CE / KD / WCE, 975 steps per arm, no student-KL anchor, no new teacher request.
selection: max tune macro-F1, tie -> max tune nDCG@10, tie -> earlier step

evaluation_policy.selection: tune selects every checkpoint with one rule; the fixed step 975 result is reported for every arm regardless of selection
evaluation_policy.sets: tune selects checkpoints; gate and F are existing development sets reported after the models are fixed; F is never used to choose a learning rate, a weight or a checkpoint
evaluation_policy.fusion: not part of this round; no fusion object is compared

execution_deviations.planned: warmup 49 steps to the peak 1e-4, then cosine to 1e-5 at step 975
execution_deviations.actual: lr(step) = peak * min(1, (step+1)/49) for step < 49, then peak * (0.1 + 0.9 * (1+cos(pi*(step-49)/926))/2)
execution_deviations.reason: The warmup numerator is (step+1)/warmup so the first update is not a zero-learning-rate update, while exactly 49 updates still ramp to the peak. Every arm shares this schedule, so no arm comparison is affected.
execution_deviations.impact: One-line change against train_direct.build_scheduler; endpoint values are verified in the self-test (step 0 = 2.04e-6, step 48 = 1e-4, step 975 = 1e-5).
